sn37.17:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
sn37.17:1.3: saddho ca hoti, hirimā ca hoti, ottāpī ca hoti, anissukī ca hoti, paññavā ca hoti. imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo
sn37.17:1.4: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti.
